articles.title: Canada's First Spacewalk in Seven Years Will Add Station Power
articles.summary: Joshua Kutryk makes his first spacewalk on October 29 with Anil Menon to install new solar arrays that will boost the station's power by about 30 percent.

articles.title: The Fire Salamander's Secret Glow
articles.summary: Fire salamanders glow green and cyan under ultraviolet light, thanks to their skin glands, but scientists do not yet know why.

articles.title: The Grave Guarded Twice Against the Undead
articles.summary: A Polish grave fitted with both a sickle and a padlock is the first known to combine two precautions against the dead rising, and its occupant seems to have been a wealthy local young woman.
